header.p: System Sequence and Activity Diagram Designs (Mermaid Rendering & High-Resolution Export Tools)

div.p: Illustrates the core asynchronous communication and lifecycle delegation between the Streamlit UI, AI Agent, Central Orchestrator, and LLM APIs upon starting a dialogue.

div.div:
sequenceDiagram autonumber actor User as User participant UI as Streamlit UI (app.py) participant Agent as AI Agent (ai_agent.py) participant Orch as Central Orchestrator (orchestrator.py) participant LLM as API Provider (Gemini/OpenAI/Ollama/etc.)
User->>UI: Configure parameters & click "Start Dialogue" / "Continue Dialogue" activate UI UI->>UI: Initialize states, set session_status = "running" UI->>UI: Start real-time countdown timer
loop Dialogue In Progress (is_running) UI->>UI: Render "Typing..." dynamic effect for active agent UI->>Agent: Call get_response(prompt, system_instruction) activate Agent
alt Provider == Ollama (Local) Agent->>LLM: Call local endpoint (pass think=False & max_tokens=1024) else Provider == Other Cloud API Agent->>LLM: Pass API Key and dialogue context end activate LLM LLM-->>Agent: Return generated dialogue content (Content / Reasoning) deactivate LLM
Agent-->>UI: Return cleaned reply text deactivate Agent
UI->>UI: Append message to chat_history, render chat bubble and provider attribution
alt Speaker Order == Sequential Mode UI->>UI: Calculate next speaker index: (current + 1) % total else Speaker Order == Nomination Mode UI->>UI: Parse speech with regex to check for "@Agent" opt Parsing succeeds & nominated agent exists UI->>UI: Set next speaker to the nominated agent end else Speaker Order == Orchestrator Mode UI->>Orch: Call get_next_speaker(chat_history, candidate_agents, api_key) activate Orch Orch->>LLM: Send orchestration prompt and full history activate LLM LLM-->>Orch: Return decided next speaker index (JSON / integer) deactivate LLM Orch-->>UI: Return next speaker index deactivate Orch end
UI->>UI: Pacing delay (1~15 seconds)
opt Timeout or User clicks "🛑 Stop Dialogue" UI->>UI: Terminate run loop, set session_status = "post_dialogue" Note over UI, User: Enter post-dialogue decision screen (display 5 options) end end deactivate UI

div.h2: 2. Dialogue State Machine & Decision Activity Diagram
div.p: Illustrates the core state transitions of the Streamlit application, specifically focusing on parameter synchronization and state resets when the user selects one of the five post-dialogue options.

div.div:
flowchart TD Start(["Start Application"]) --> InitState["Initialize session_state
session_status = 'setup'"] InitState --> SetupView["Render Setup Panel"]
SetupView --> SubmitCheck{"User clicks submit?"} SubmitCheck -- "No" --> SetupView
SubmitCheck -- "Yes (Start / Continue Dialogue)" --> InitSession["Initialize dialogue based on state:
- setup / restart: clear history, reset index
- continue: keep history, safely adjust index"]
InitSession --> SetRunning["Set session_status = 'running'"]
SetRunning --> LoopStart["Dialogue loop start"] LoopStart --> GenReply["AI Agent generates response"] GenReply --> UpdateUI["Update chat history & UI bubbles"] UpdateUI --> CheckStop{"Countdown timer expired
or clicked 'Stop Dialogue'?"}
CheckStop -- "No" --> Delay["Pacing delay"] Delay --> LoopStart
CheckStop -- "Yes" --> SetPostState["Set session_status = 'post_dialogue'"]
SetPostState --> PostDialogueView["Render post-dialogue view
(Show Markdown preview, download button, and 5 action buttons)"]
PostDialogueView --> Choice{"Which button does the user select?"}
%% 1. Keep params & continue Choice -- "1. Keep params & continue" --> Act1["Reset timer
Keep history
session_status = 'running'"] Act1 --> LoopStart
%% 2. Edit params & continue Choice -- "2. Edit params & continue" --> Act2["Call sync_inputs_from_agents()
Sync active parameters to inputs
session_status = 'editing_continue'"] Act2 --> SetupView
%% 3. Keep params & restart Choice -- "3. Keep params & restart" --> Act3["Reset timer
Clear history, reset index
session_status = 'running'"] Act3 --> LoopStart
%% 4. Edit params & restart Choice -- "4. Edit params & restart" --> Act4["Call sync_inputs_from_agents()
Sync parameters to inputs
Clear history, reset index
session_status = 'editing_restart'"] Act4 --> SetupView
%% 5. End conversation Choice -- "5. End conversation" --> Act5["Call sync_inputs_from_agents()
Clear history, reset index
Reset all params and API keys to defaults
session_status = 'setup'"] Act5 --> SetupView
%% Style Colors style Start fill:#2d3748,stroke:#4a5568,color:#fff style InitState fill:#1a202c,stroke:#2d3748,color:#fff style SetupView fill:#2b6cb0,stroke:#2b6cb0,color:#fff style LoopStart fill:#2d3748,stroke:#4a5568,color:#fff style SetRunning fill:#2d3748,stroke:#4a5568,color:#fff style GenReply fill:#2d3748,stroke:#4a5568,color:#fff style SetPostState fill:#276749,stroke:#276749,color:#fff style PostDialogueView fill:#276749,stroke:#276749,color:#fff
subgraph RunningState ["Running State (running)"] LoopStart GenReply UpdateUI CheckStop Delay end
subgraph PostActions ["Post-Dialogue Action States"] Act1 Act2 Act3 Act4 Act5 end
style RunningState fill:#1e293b,stroke:#38bdf8,stroke-dasharray:5 style PostActions fill:#14532d,stroke:#4ade80,stroke-dasharray:5
